description: CRITICAL: The generator must emit one suite object per operation. Shared setup and cleanup live at the suite level. Individual tests only contain the invalid request and the violated constraint text.

suite_structure.operation: REQUIRED - Operation name, such as NFRegister or NFStatusSubscribe
suite_structure.path: REQUIRED - Operation path from the API specification
suite_structure.method: REQUIRED - HTTP method for the operation

setup.description: REQUIRED - Shared setup request executed before every test in this operation suite. Use an empty array if no setup is needed.
setup.resource_url: REQUIRED - Full resource URL for the setup step
setup.request_body: REQUIRED - Valid JSON request body for the setup step. Omit if method is GET or DELETE.

cleanup.description: REQUIRED - Shared cleanup request executed after every test in this operation suite. Use an empty array if no cleanup is needed.
cleanup.resource_url: REQUIRED - Full resource URL for the cleanup step
cleanup.request_body: OPTIONAL - Only include if the cleanup step needs a body.

tests.name: REQUIRED - Short descriptive name of the invalid test case

request.description: REQUIRED - The invalid request for this test case. Do not include driving_state or setup data here.
request.resource_url: REQUIRED - Full resource URL for the invalid request
request.request_body: REQUIRED - Invalid JSON request body that violates the constraint. Omit if method is GET or DELETE.

violated_constraints: REQUIRED - A single string describing the constraint violated by the test

tests.name: Subscription with invalid callback URI scheme
violated_constraints: The callbackReference.notifyUri value must use a valid HTTPS URI.

example_test_case.name: Missing required field nfType
violated_constraints: An NFProfile MUST include the properties 'nfInstanceId', 'nfType', and 'nfStatus'.
